newsitem.title: CANADA: Power's Desmarais to have bypass surgery.
newsitem.headline: Power's Desmarais to have bypass surgery.

text.p: Paul Desmarais, chairman of the executive committee of Power Corp of Canada, will undergo heart bypass surgery shortly, the company said on Wednesday.

The company said the procedure was to relieve cardiovascular discomfort Desmarais recently experienced, and that his doctors were confident he would make a full recovery and resume his normal activities in the near future.
Power spokesman Ted Johnson told Reuters that Desmarais, 69, did not suffer a heart attack and was not in the hospital.
"It was just in the last few days that he had discomfort, and the best advice was that he should do it (the surgery) now rather than later," Johnson said.
"He had a working lunch with his senior officers today," Johnson said.
